page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c9i.8xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing an Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor running at a clock speed of 3.2 GHz. The instance is equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, which translates to a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for persistent data. It provides a baseline network bandwidth of 20 Gbps and does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio offer a resource-dense configuration tailored for compute-heavy workloads, minimizing memory overhead costs for tasks that do not require large memory footprints.

The ecs.c9i.8xlarge is designed for high-compute workloads. Appropriate use cases include batch processing, high-performance web serving, scientific modeling, video encoding, and distributed analytics where CPU performance is the primary bottleneck.
